job.title: Finance Manager - Contract
job.description:

Position Overview

  • Strong cash flow and debtor management.
  • Clear and useful Board and Executive reporting
  • Reduction in manual spreadsheet-based reporting through dashboard-driven insights.
  • Scalable Power BI reporting that consolidates financial data across multiple entities
  • Commercial insights that support better business decisions.

Preferred Experience

  • CA or CPA qualified.
  • Experience in professional services, consulting, engineering, property, construction or project management businesses.
  • Strong management accounting and commercial finance capability.
  • Experience with budgeting, forecasting and cash flow management.
  • Experience preparing Board and Executive reporting.
  • Strong experience with Power BI (or similar reporting platforms
  • Strong commercial acumen and communication skills.
  • Ability to operate in a hands-on environment while supporting executive decision making.
